scope: All 120 remaining listings in the reviewed Pennrose apartment directory after comparison with the tracked US collection. This is an operator-catalog review, not a complete national inventory.
method: Read current property pages and linked program documents; compare campus and phase listings; verify addresses and source/title duplicates; source project media and verify public Azure blobs; check public pin APIs and pages after publishing.
interpretationNotes: Published ranges can include market-rate homes; tiers are identified only where a source explicitly assigns them.
Older tiered schedules remain labeled with their effective dates and are not called new lease quotes.
Program rents and voucher tenant contributions are separate.
A listed price, contact form or application link is not treated as proof of current vacancy.
Where an original milestone was not established, timeline uses the explicitly labeled research-verification date, not a guessed opening date.
Generic coming-soon graphics and nonphotographic inventory tables are not used as pin media.
